title: The diffuse molecular component in the nuclear bulge of the Milky Way
question: Is there diffuse, low-density molecular gas in the Galactic bulge, detectable via 3-mm molecular absorption against the quasar J1744-312, and what is its chemistry and mass?

data.sensitivity: rms 1.35-4.01 mJy per ~10 km/s channel depending on window

what.value: Quasar flux density 0.571 Jy at 103 GHz, 0.563 Jy at 91.5 GHz

evidence.quote: The quasar has a flux density of 0.571 Jy at 103 GHz and 0.563 Jy at 91.5 GHz in the ALMA-Band 3 calibrator source catalog

what.value: CN vs H2 power-law relation (slope 1.31) used to infer N(H2)

evidence.quote: The relation between N(CN) and N(H$_2$) is non-linear with a power-law slope of 1.31.

what.value: Comparison column densities of cyanogen/HCO+/CnHm families from earlier absorption studies

evidence.quote: We include the data from (cite: Liszt_Lucas_2001), (cite: Godard_et_al_2010), (cite: Muller_et_al_2011), and the present work.

recipe.method: Single spectrum toward quasar centre; line-to-continuum ratio
CDMS and JPL catalogs for identification; Gaussian fits to continuum-subtracted spectra; CLASS HFS method for HCO, CN, CCH
key_parameters: Linewidths fixed to values from isolated-component Gaussian fit when fits did not converge

recipe.method: tau = -ln(1+S_l/S_c); N from integrated tau with Gaussian integral

recipe.goal: Estimate N(H2) and mass of diffuse gas
recipe.method: N(H2) from N(CN)-N(H2) relation and from HCO+ abundance; mass for spherical geometry with radius equal to projected distance to GC

evidence.quote: we can infer a molecular hydrogen column of $1.12\times 10^{22}$ cm$^{-2}$ for the potentially local gas (0 km s$^{-1}$)
$2.71\times 10^{21}$ cm$^{-2}$ for the velocity component at $-153$ km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: Mass of diffuse bulge gas (upper estimate)

evidence.quote: the total mass of the diffuse component could be as high as $1.9\times 10^{7}$ M$_{\odot}$
translating into a $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C isotopic ratio of 65 (HCO$^+$/H$^{13}$CO$^+$) and 80 (HCN/H$^{13}$CN)

not_stated_but_needed: Excitation temperature used explicitly (T_ex=T_bg=2.73 K implied by Q_2.73)
Extraction aperture/pixel for the spectrum and continuum-level definition
How the 3-sigma upper limits were computed
Geometry details for the mass estimate
score_reason: Single project code and simple analysis with equations, but several settings unstated.
rediscovery_reason: ALMA data from a single project, simple analysis, numeric table of tau and N.
